pairs.subject: i18n
pairs.evidence: i18n/request.ts:13 Request configuration loads the entire active locale as one unit, bypassing the standard's independently loadable sections.

techniques.evidence: i18n/request.ts:13 The loading boundary is a whole locale JSON file rather than a locale-section pair.

pairs.subject: i18n
pairs.evidence: scripts/i18n-check.mjs:164 The catalog checker accepts copied source-language values and mojibake values, allowing these defects through its structural checks.

techniques.evidence: scripts/i18n-check.mjs:164 An in-memory source and German catalog both containing 'Hello {name}' produced no problems; key parity is enforced, but untranslated-value identity is not.

scripts/i18n/catalog-check.mjs:232 Content validation checks control characters, syntax and dashes without the required mojibake signature; a target containing U+00C3 followed by U+00A9 produced no problems.

scripts/i18n-check.mjs:235 The shared-primitive attribute scan targets aria-label; broader attribute checks are limited to selected marketing directories, leaving the required extraction boundary incomplete.

pairs.subject: i18n
pairs.evidence: app/features/shared/matchLabels.ts:72 Unknown match-label codes degrade to English or raw identifiers without reporting the mapping miss, hiding production vocabulary drift.

techniques.evidence: app/features/shared/matchLabels.ts:72 The explicit missing-code branch returns fallback text or the token without the production miss telemetry required by the standard.

pairs.subject: i18n
pairs.evidence: app/_lib/catalog-translator.ts:54 Candidate communications receive a translator without source-catalog merging, so a missing translation can expose a catalog address instead of readable English.

techniques.evidence: app/_lib/catalog-translator.ts:54 commsTranslator delegates to this loader, which supplies only the target catalog; removing comms.team from an in-memory German catalog made this construction return 'comms.team' despite an English source value.

pairs.subject: i18n
pairs.evidence: app/features/shared/MatchReasoningPanel.tsx:91 The reasoning badge appends a separately translated suffix to its translated source label, fixing message composition outside the translator's control.

techniques.evidence: app/features/shared/MatchReasoningPanel.tsx:91 This suffix follows the independently translated sourceLlm/sourceRuleBased expression, matching the standard's named fragment-plus-suffix failure.
